_about: Public-domain Francis Landey Patton (1843-1932), Princeton theologian and president of Princeton College and Seminary, for the Word Hoard: The Inspiration of the Scriptures (1869), the syllabus of his lectures on theism (1888), A Discourse in Memory of A. A. Hodge (1887), The Letter and the Spirit (1890), Caspar Wistar Hodge: a Memorial Address (1891), A Summary of Christian Doctrine (1898) and Fundamental Christianity (1926), from Internet Archive scans. Published before 1930, so public domain in the US although he died in 1932. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 57 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
